faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) position is 05 September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's/Postgraduate degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Chemistry, or a related discipline. Additionally, 03 years of post-qualification experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per the Government rules for candidates belonging to reserved categories. The maximum age limit for the post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of ₹56,000, along with 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) recruitment will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi.
